repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Stat catalogue contains no honest rare-event PN/PS point-identification frontier.

published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 gives regular efficient PN/PS inference; CuellarKennedy2020 gives regular projected-PC inference; ZhangWangMiao2025 gives efficient inference for generally partially identified PN bounds rather than this monotone rare-count point-PN/PS frontier.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the finite-expected-diameter impossibility template, but not the bounded monotone-PN causal submodel or its effective-count rate.
HannartNaveau2018 selects an event by causal evidence, but does not provide selection-honest learned-score confidence-set inversion.

novelty_flags.label: conj:lr-frontier / ass:rare-scale-remainder
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed sharp upper frontier is conditional on ass:rare-scale-remainder, which assumes the learned-score stability at exactly the target rare-event scale instead of deriving it from primitive learner conditions; this cannot count as a derived statistical frontier advance.

soundness_flags.label: def:sieve-likelihood
soundness_flags.one_line: The resampling law P_ξ and Λ_n^*(t) are not defined: it is unclear how the data-dependent empirical weights, covariate support, and retained score marks enter the stated four-cell Poisson-binomial experiment, so p_n is not yet a specified measurable calibration map.

soundness_flags.label: lem:learning / def:crossfit
soundness_flags.one_line: Neither the spline dimensions/knots nor the fitting criterion are specified, so the displayed exact Hölder rates and the claimed sufficient rare-scale remainder cannot be determined from def:crossfit.

soundness_flags.label: lem:learning
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated refinement does not include every sequence with nd_n→∞: for d_n=n^{-b}, it additionally requires β_0/(2β_0+p)>b/2 and a product-rate restriction, which diverging effective count alone does not imply.

soundness_flags.label: ass:rare-scale-remainder
soundness_flags.one_line: This membership condition constrains the named off-fold estimator \widehat\eta rather than a primitive property of P_n; state nuisance estimability existentially at the law level and put the selected spline learner in the construction/theorem inputs.

soundness_flags.label: ass:rare-localization
soundness_flags.one_line: The uniform anti-concentration condition \|\omega_n\|_∞≤C_\omega is strong and load-bearing, while the climate/clinical justification only asserts rarity and does not establish that factual risk cannot concentrate in covariate regions.

soundness_flags.label: tldr / honest_scope / lem:lf-membership
soundness_flags.one_line: The prose calls the least-favorable causal submodel certified, but its membership is explicitly conditional on ass:rare-scale-remainder and ass:score-nondegeneracy holding along that submodel.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:lower / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower theorem is conditional on the declared observed-law class containing the covariate-homogeneous least-favorable submodel; current membership additionally conditions on its score-remainder and nondegeneracy premises.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The diameter lower rate applies to every measurable confidence-set procedure honest over a PN class containing that stated submodel, conditional on those membership premises.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace ass:rare-scale-remainder with primitive, law-level nuisance-estimability conditions and derive the d_n-scaled score remainder for the named spline learner; if this is not currently feasible, make attainability an OEQ rather than assuming the upper-bound engine.

Define the finite resampling experiment completely: its conditional sample space, treatment of empirical covariate weights and repeated covariates, simulated score marks, P_ξ, Λ_n^*, and the measurable least-favorable tail rule.
Specify spline dimensions, knot growth, fitting loss, and the exact joint d_n/smoothness regime; delete the false claim that nd_n→∞ alone meets the displayed refinement.
Either justify rare localization through a concrete climate/clinical design in which it is empirically plausible, or weaken it and state the resulting localized rate separately.

recommended_next_step: Revise the upper construction into a fully defined experiment and derive its rare-scale learning condition from primitive assumptions before resubmitting the otherwise novel field-tier frontier.
